categories.main_business_segments: Yimikang Tech.Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the digital infrastructure sector, providing full lifecycle green solutions. Its main business segments include key equipment manufacturing (precision air conditioning and cooling systems), intelligent engineering services (digital infrastructure planning, design, construction, and operation), software development (data center operation management and energy-saving solutions), and smart services (equipment maintenance, energy management, and digital operation services). The company has transitioned from a precision air conditioning provider to a comprehensive digital infrastructure solutions provider.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced temperature control technologies including precision air conditioning, liquid cooling systems (Nexliq2.0), indirect evaporative cooling, and integrated fluorine pump systems. It employs intelligent manufacturing with robotic production lines and automated CNC equipment to enhance product quality and flexibility. Software development leverages AIoT platforms, digital twin technology, BIM, and modular prefabrication for data center design and operation. The company emphasizes R&D in energy-efficient cooling and digital management platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yimikang serves data centers, telecom base stations, smart cities, healthcare facilities, and enterprises requiring digital infrastructure. Key customers include China's three major telecom operators, internet giants, financial institutions, and government entities. The company also targets emerging markets in Southeast Asia and the Middle East, aligning with initiatives like 'East Data West Computing' and the digital economy expansion.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant presence in regions such as Chengdu, Xi'an, and other high-tech zones. It has expanded overseas markets covering Southeast Asia countries including Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines, and Middle Eastern countries like Oman. Domestic coverage includes major data center clusters such as Zhongwei, Qingyang, Tianfu, Shaoguan, Yangtze River Delta, and Zhangjiakou.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yimikang operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital infrastructure supply chain. It manufactures key temperature control equipment and provides integrated engineering, software, and operational services, covering the full lifecycle from design and construction to maintenance and energy management. The company acts as a system integrator and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in green and intelligent cooling technologies, digital twin and BIM integration, AIoT-enabled software platforms, and modular prefabricated data center solutions. R&D focuses on enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and scalability of temperature control systems, including liquid cooling and multi-source cooling technologies. Strategic emphasis is on supporting digital economy growth, AI computing demands, and sustainable development aligned with national policies on carbon neutrality and digital infrastructure.
categories.revenue_model: Yimikang generates revenue primarily through product sales of precision air conditioning and cooling systems, engineering construction contracts, software licensing and services, and ongoing smart operation and maintenance services. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance for products, progress-based recognition for engineering projects, and over time for service contracts. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yimikang positions itself as a leading domestic brand in digital infrastructure temperature control and integrated solutions, with a comprehensive product line and full industry chain layout. It competes with other Chinese and international providers of data center cooling equipment and engineering services. The company leverages its strong R&D capabilities, extensive customer base, and participation in national standards development to maintain competitive advantages in the precision environment and digital infrastructure sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yimikang reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.14 billion, a 42.84% increase year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 87.14 million, the loss narrowed significantly compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 1.68 billion with equity of RMB 321 million. Cash flow from operations improved markedly, reflecting enhanced sales and collection efficiency. The company continues to invest in R&D and expand its market presence domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yimikang emphasizes its unique value as a one-stop provider of green, intelligent, and full lifecycle digital infrastructure solutions. Its differentiation lies in advanced temperature control technologies, integrated engineering and software capabilities, and comprehensive smart services that improve energy efficiency and operational reliability. The company’s strong brand recognition, extensive patent portfolio, and alignment with national digital and carbon-neutral strategies further enhance its competitive positioning and customer trust.
